breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Crank–Nicolson'. The agent correctly resolved this by selecting only the 'Crank–Nicolson' method, which matches the ground truth prompt. The generated specification provides the correct formula for the Crank-Nicolson scheme and makes no mention of the incorrect Euler method.
